Mannar Mannanae Video Song from Mannan Tamil movie featuring Rajinikanth and Vijayashanti. Mannam Tamil movie also stars Khushboo, Visu, Goundamani, Manorama and Pandari Bai among others. Music by Ilayaraja,directed by P Vasu and produced by Prabhu.
Song : Mannar Mannanae
Singer : S Janaki, SPB
Music : Ilayaraja
Lyrics : Vaali
